label: Co-brand Lockup
description: Partners' marks side by side in a corner (Claude + Quotient on a joint webinar film), a thin divider (or an x) between them, sized from the box height. A quiet corner bug that stays on for the scene: a short, wide box in the upper left (about 5% of the frame tall). Each mark is { builtin: 'claude' } (the orange Claude spark, label 'Claude' adds the name) or { src } (a logo image, e.g. the brand kit's wordmark).

marks.label: The marks, left to right: { builtin?: 'claude', src?: image url, label?: name, color?: spark colour, scale?: height vs the box (default 1) }

ink.label: Colour of a text label (default near-black)

at.label: Seconds: fades in (default 0: present from the first frame)
